name: Temple of Antoninus and Faustina
type: temple; archaeological site; Roman temple; destroyed building or structure
text: The Temple of Antoninus and Faustina was an ancient Roman temple in Rome, which was later converted into a Roman Catholic church, San Lorenzo in Miranda. It is located in the Forum Romanum, on the Via Sacra, opposite the Regia.

depictions.name: Temple of Antoninus and Faustina
depictions.text: The Temple of Antoninus and Faustina (Italian: Tempio di Antonino e Faustina) is an ancient temple in Rome constructed during the 2nd century by the Roman Emperor Antoninus Pius to pay homage to his late wife.
